summary: Adds seven Panama investor residence categories as programmes (decision 15): forestry, agrarian, small-business, City of Knowledge, call-centre, export processing zone and Panamá-Pacífico investors, with their rules from the 2008 migration regulation (DE 320), launch and legal-basis events, and their SNM approval counts 2010-2024. Also stores the '-' (nil) cells of existing Panama categories in the same tables as zeros (decision 6).

programs.name: Panama residence as forestry investor (Inversionista Forestal)
programs.notes: Residence for foreigners investing in reforestation or forest plantations authorised by the National Environment Authority, personally or through a company (at most two foreign applicants per company). DE 320 of 2008 sets two permits: temporary, B/.60,000 on at least 10 hectares, six years renewable every two (arts. 95, 100-102); permanent, B/.80,000 on at least 20 hectares (arts. 180-182); B/.2,000 more per dependant in both. SNM approvals fell from 71 in 2010 to 2 in 2020 and none in 2021; the category does not appear separately in the 2022-2026 tables. The OECD listed a Panama 'Reforestation Investor Visa' as potentially high-risk for tax reporting in October 2018 and removed it in November 2018. Launch is the 2008 regulation, the first stored text; the SNM table note says its series also rests on the 1960 migration law. Current status and amendments after 2008 not checked.

programs.name: Panama temporary residence as agrarian investor (Inversionista Agrario)
programs.notes: Temporary residence for foreigners who have invested at least B/.60,000, personally or through a company, in agriculture, livestock or aquaculture in lines the Agriculture Ministry considers of national interest, plus B/.500 per dependant; valid six years, renewable every two (DE 320 of 2008, arts. 95-99). SNM approvals: 35 in 2010-2021 (none above 12 a year), and 3 extensions in 2023. Current status and amendments after 2008 not checked.

programs.name: Panama residence as small-business investor (Inversionista de Pequeña Empresa)
programs.notes: Known only from the SNM statistics: 478 permits approved 2010-2021, 180 of them in 2010, falling to none after 2016 apart from 1 in 2019. No stored document sets its requirements or start: the 2008 migration regulation (DE 320) has no small-business investor section, so the category may come from earlier rules. Current status not checked.

programs.name: Panama residence as investor or businessperson in the City of Knowledge (Inversionista o Empresario Ciudad del Saber)
programs.notes: SNM category for businesspeople at the City of Knowledge (Ciudad del Saber), a research and business park run by a foundation under Decreto Ley 6 of 1999. In the 2008 regulation (DE 320, art. 113) the matching subcategory is 'empresario o ejecutivo' of the City of Knowledge Foundation: it needs the Foundation's certificate that the company may operate there and a parent-company letter, and sets no investment amount. Launch is left empty because no stored text makes investing the route; whether the category is in scope under decision 15 needs a second look. SNM approvals: 301 in 2010-2021, 5 extensions in 2023, 48 in 2024. Current status not checked.

programs.name: Panama residence as call-centre investor (Inversionista de Centro de Llamadas para Uso Comercial (Call Center) para Exportación)
programs.notes: Permanent residence for foreigners investing in a company providing call-centre services for export; DE 320 of 2008 (arts. 214-216) gives it the same requirements as the export processing zone investor permit (B/.250,000 from abroad, art. 211) and says this follows Decreto Ejecutivo 97 of 2002 (not stored), which may itself have created the permit. SNM approvals: 2 in 2013, 81 in 2021, 39 in 2022; not shown separately in 2023-2026. Current status and amendments after 2008 not checked.

programs.name: Panama residence as investor in an export processing zone (Inversionista en Zonas Procesadoras para la Exportación)
programs.notes: Permanent residence for foreigners who invest at least B/.250,000 from abroad in a promoter or operator of an export processing zone or a company in one (DE 320 of 2008, arts. 211-213), referring to the zones law, Ley 25 of 1992 (not stored). SNM approvals ('Inversionista o Empr. de Zonas Procesadoras'): 52 in 2010-2021, at most 16 a year. Current status and amendments after 2008 not checked.

programs.name: Panama residence as investor in the Panamá-Pacífico special economic area (Inversionista del Área Económica Especial Panamá-Pacífico)
programs.notes: Permanent residence for foreigners who invest at least B/.250,000 from abroad in the risk capital of a company of the Panamá-Pacífico special economic area (the former Howard air base) or its developer or operator; the company must be authorised under Ley 41 of 2004 (not stored) and employ at least three Panamanians (DE 320 of 2008, arts. 206-208). The SNM tables have no separate investor row for the area (only employee and technician categories). Current status and amendments after 2008 not checked.
